newsitem.title: USA: Einstein/Noah to offer $75 mln of debt.
newsitem.headline: Einstein/Noah to offer $75 mln of debt.

text.p: Einstein/Noah Bagel Corp Tuesday proposed a private offering of $75 million of convertible subordinated debentures due 2004.
Einstein/Noah said the proceeds of the offering will be used primarily to fund new store development.

The company said the proposed debentures will be offered to qualified institutional buyers and certain institutional accredited investors and may also be offered to foreign persons. The company, however, has not registered the debentures under the Securities Act of 1933 and they may not be publicly offered or sold in the United States without registration or without an exemption from the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933 and applicable state securities laws.
Einstein/Noah Bagel franchises the Einstein Bros. Bagels and Noah's New York Bagels brands to bagel cafes and bakeries.
